metadata.description: Report civic issues to your municipality and follow them until they are fixed.

common.tagline: Report it. Track it. See it fixed.

citizen.headline: Tell your city what needs <accent>fixing</accent>.
citizen.intro: Potholes, overflowing bins, broken streetlights, blocked drains: report them to your municipality and follow each one until it's done.
citizen.reportComingSoon: Coming soon: reporting opens in the next release.
citizen.signInToSeeTitle: Sign in to see your reports
citizen.signInToSeeBody: All you need is your mobile number. No password.
citizen.noReportsBody: When you report an issue, you'll be able to follow its progress here.
citizen.step1Body: Take a photo, drop a pin and choose what kind of problem it is.
citizen.step2Body: Your report reaches the department and ward responsible for it.
citizen.step3Body: Follow each update, and confirm when the work is actually done.
citizen.footer: CivicPulse never shows your name or phone number publicly.

access.title: You don't have access to this page
access.body: You're signed in as {name}, and this account's role doesn't include this area. If you think it should, ask your municipal administrator.

field.title: My work orders
field.subtitle: Jobs assigned to you will appear here.
field.emptyBody: When a supervisor assigns you a job, you'll see the location, details and photos here.
field.offlineBody: Offline updates will be supported in a later release. For now, keep this page open on a connection.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.description: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

login.title: Sign in to CivicPulse
login.brandBody: One place to report what's broken in your neighbourhood and see who is fixing it.
login.brandPoint1: Sign in with just your mobile number
login.brandPoint2: Follow every report from submission to fix
login.brandPoint3: Your phone number is never shown publicly
login.phoneStepHint: We'll text you a 6-digit code. New numbers get a citizen account automatically.
login.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
login.attemptsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
login.codeExpiredBody: Request a new code to continue.
login.mfaStepHint: Staff accounts need a second step. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mfaExpired: Two-step verification took too long. Start again with your mobile number.
login.privacy: We use your number only to sign you in and send updates about your reports.

overview.title: Welcome back
overview.description: Manage who can work in CivicPulse and review what has changed.
overview.usersBody: Add staff, assign roles and departments, and deactivate accounts.
overview.auditBody: See who changed what, and when, with before and after values.
overview.queueBody: Triage, assign and track citizen reports with SLA timers.
overview.mapBody: See open issues on a map, in sync with the queue.

users.title: Users
users.description: Staff and citizen accounts in this municipality. Staff need at least one role to work in the console.
users.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No users found} one {# user found} other {# users found}}
users.cantDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.
users.createDescription: They'll sign in with this mobile number. Roles decide what they can see and do.
users.nameRequired: Enter a name with at least 2 characters.
users.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
users.phoneTaken: Someone already uses this mobile number.
users.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
users.rolesHint: Limit a role to one department or ward, or leave both open for the whole municipality.
users.rolesHintNoScopes: Roles apply to the whole municipality. Department and ward scoping needs configuration access.
users.rolesDuplicate: The same role and scope is listed twice.
users.editRolesDescription: Saving replaces all of this user's roles.
users.deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in until the account is activated again. Their history stays in the audit log.
users.activateBody: They'll be able to sign in again with their mobile number.

session.offlineDescription: Check your connection. You can keep browsing, but signing in won't work until we're back online.

errors.network_error: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_response: The server sent something unexpected. Please try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.token_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.tenant_mismatch: This account belongs to a different municipality.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with an existing record.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.rate_limited_wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.validation_error: Some details aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This request was already sent with different details. Close the form and start again.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check the message and try again.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
